UN Human Rights Office Concerned Over Mass Detentions During Protests

The UN Human Rights office has expressed concern over mass detentions that occurred in Delhi and Mumbai amid protests. A spokesperson urged Indian authorities to exercise "utmost restraint" in responding to peaceful protesters, in line with India's democratic traditions and human rights obligations. The office also called for the release of detainees.
